title: Impromptu No.2, Op.31
notable_excerpt: Key: F minor. Chord journey: i - v2 - III (Picardy-like major) - i - bVI7 - bVII2 - v, III - i7 - v - bVII6 - v6 sequence, vi - I53#3, closes on F major. Texture: rippling sixteenth-note figuration over a sustained melodic line.
